full_judgment: 9. Mr. Shamsur Rahman, the learned Advocate appearing on behalf of the writ petition-respondents in both the appeals submits that the present respondents by filling applications expressed their desire of returning back to the service of the PDB but PDB failed to act on the said application instead, it sat over the same and the High Court Division upon considering the aforesaid important fact passed the impugned judgment and order which does not suffer from any error of law. He next submits that the High Court Division while passing the impugned judgment relied on the decision of Writ Petition No. 977 of 2008 and 3778 of 2008 passed on the same facts and circumstances and the law which have not been challenged by PDB before this Division rather it complied with the directions passed in those writ petitions. Such action of the appellants (PDB) in challenging the impugned judgment and order is discriminatory. Consequently, the appeals should be dismissed for ends of justice.
